# The relational model (generated by model/spec.rkt; do not edit)

One table per resource type and a child table per repeating element, from FHIR R6. Every row carries its resource's key (`<base>_id`), `patient_id` where the resource is patient data, and `<level>_idx` per repeating level (the element's position). Dates are ISO text as written.

## `patient`

Patient, one row per resource

| Column | Type | FHIRPath (R6) |
|---|---|---|
| `patient_id` | TEXT | `getResourceKey()` |
| `data_source` | TEXT | HEDIS data-source tag |
| `gender` | TEXT | `gender` |
| `birth_date` | TEXT | `birthDate` |
| `deceased_boolean` | INTEGER | `deceased.ofType(boolean)` |
| `deceased_datetime` | TEXT | `deceased.ofType(dateTime)` |
